Subject: AuroraCloud marketplace integration — next steps & technical slotting

Hi Alex / Rajiv —

Thanks again for the call this morning. High-level recap: AuroraCloud is evaluating Redwood for marketplace-hosted inference (multi-tenant offering) with a pilot focused on a private tenant per customer and native marketplace billing. Key technical concerns you flagged were VPC connectivity, KMS integration, and deployment timing for Q3.

Next steps I propose:
- Schedule a 60-minute technical deep dive (Redwood infra + Aurora integration owners + your infra lead).
- Share a one-page mutual action plan (attached) and a short network requirements doc for your infra team.
- Loop procurement for commercial/contractual items (we can coordinate DocuSign MSA once technical fit is confirmed).

Proposed deep-dive slots (PST):
1) Tue May 4 — 09:00–10:00
2) Wed May 5 — 13:00–14:00
3) Thu May 6 — 08:30–09:30

Please confirm which slot works best or propose two alternatives. I attached a draft mutual_action_plan.xlsx for visibility.

Deliverables for the deep dive (what we'll cover):
- Marketplace onboarding flow and chargeback mapping
- Network/VPC peering, ingress rules, and allowed egress
- KMS/HSM options and key management patterns
- Deployment sizing and pilot success criteria

If Rajiv can't make any of those, please let me know his availability; we can also do an initial infra-only sync if needed.

Thanks — looking forward to lining this up.

Best,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Partner Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
